settings.heading: The hotel
settings.text: Savi Hotels & Resorts, Operational Lead, Jaipur, January 2021 to July 2026. Kartavya took entrepreneurship-through-acquisition control of a leased Savi property within SRBS Group — from handover and F&B inventory through meeting rooms, banquet spaces, MICE catering, and walk-in lunches. He partnered with head chefs on kitchen standards and does not claim a formal line-cook title.

settings.heading: The restaurant
settings.text: Siya The Restaurant, SRBS Group, Menu Engineering Consultant, 2025 to 2026. On-property menu design and back-of-house economics: two years of handwritten kitchen registers digitised, FIFO controls, and a margin-times-velocity matrix for 191 dishes.

settings.heading: Practice
settings.text: Independent culinary and kitchen-systems practice; published London restaurant rotations; small-batch food-science work under PACA; a modelled precision-nutrition diagnostic for Danone YoPRO. Earlier still: Hospiteri, a hotel management system, and Soma, a Class 12 marketing project for the samosa snack industry.

settings.heading: The house
settings.text: Maison Tavo is public so that standard can sit in the open: limited editions, honest materials, a storefront that behaves like a pass rather than a shout. The design story is deliberate synthesis — casting, forging, and room language held as one texture. Spec depth and craft surface share the same pass; software is how the rooms are built, not the tasting menu.

settings.heading: Our story
settings.lede: Maison Tavo is Kartavya Jharwal’s food house. The public record begins in Jaipur hospitality: a leased hotel, a property restaurant, and the work of feeding rooms, banquets, and walk-in tables from one kitchen.
settings.place_1_text: Hospitality kitchens and clay grain — the Terre lineage as kitchen memory, not borrowed prestige.
settings.place_2_text: Blade discipline and strip geometry — Kuro as craft language on the board.
settings.place_3_text: Composition and restraint — dual depth for the technologist and the curator on one surface.
